description:
Skari and Luka will be presenting the Black Templars pushing back against a DENSELY occupied Ork position in one of the many battles of Armageddon. 

We're trying new missions, new detachments, and some of the new models. This is our first of MANY 11th Edition battle reports to come.

In collaboration with Skari from Skaredcast - http://patreon.com/skaredcast
